name: vespera
description: **FastAPI-like developer experience for Rust.** Zero-config OpenAPI 3.1 generation for Axum.
author: devfive

scripts.prelint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace --all-features
scripts.prelint:fix: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --fix --allow-dirty -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all && cargo check --workspace --all-features
scripts.posttest: cargo tarpaulin --engine llvm --out Lcov Stdout --workspace --exclude app --fail-under 100
